extracted.intended_audience: readers of 19th-century travel and natural history narratives (naturalists, mariners, general educated public)
extracted.subtask_description: Descriptive travel / natural-history narrative typical of 19th-century voyage accounts, focusing on coastal surveys, geography, tides, local fauna, and ethnographic observations. Useful as an example of observational, place-based descriptive writing rather than a prescriptive rubric.
